critique.evidence: Strong, cohesive defense-console art direction: disciplined near-black palette, crisp cyan/yellow/red accents, bold headline hierarchy, and a polished residual-risk card that adapts cleanly across all three section viewports. It falls short of demo-ready excellence because desktop has excessive empty vertical space and an imbalanced hero annotation, tablet/card spacing feels loose, and mobile packs several tiny mono labels into dense blocks. The actual tablet/mobile headers look visibly truncated and crowded; navigation disappears beyond the horizontal rail, the brand vanishes on mobile, and the low-contrast nav text has unresolved contrast evidence.
critique.fix: Tighten desktop vertical rhythm and align the artifact annotation more deliberately with the hero. Increase small-label readability, simplify mobile card density, and redesign the tablet/mobile header with a clear current-section indicator and intentional overflow affordance while preserving the brand and improving nav contrast.
